findings.rationale: Global success flag and swallowed results overstated durability. Each ranking/queue/pack row has pending/error/conflict state; restore distinguishes device-save outcome from remote sync. Unknown outcomes use CAS readback.

Concurrent ordinary full-row saves can commit out of order. Browser request response delay alone is not proof of reversed DB commit, but audit gate correctly delayed mock commit itself; CAS and serialized read/write operations now prevent stale commits.

New anonymous timestamp used to outrank account snapshot and distort order; explicit reviewed additions now append with account order authoritative. Generic cross-device merge toast no longer used by load.
